ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 65% high-intensity (white/cream) pixels located on the outer lobes versus 35% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated at the peduncle connection and along the trailing edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black region originates at the central peduncle and extends laterally. Left lobe contains a cluster of approximately 10-12 discrete, high-contrast dark circular spots in the upper-medial quadrant. Right lobe contains a single prominent dark spot near the distal tip. Dark pigmentation forms a continuous band along the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression; calculated interior angle of approximately 35 degrees relative to the lobe midlines.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration with variable pixel-amplitude; most extreme peaks (3-8 pixels in depth) are localized on the distal outer thirds of both lobes, while the medial sections near the notch exhibit lower-amplitude, smoother undulations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature on the upper edge of both lobes, sweeping upward and outward to sharpened, slightly hooked distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-intensity white circular pixel groups (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Left lobe exhibits a specific constellation of dark circular spots in the white field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct dark linear streaks (rake marks) are visible on the lower section of the left lobe, cutting across the white pigmentation field at a diagonal angle.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization and associated tissue irregularity on the distal margins of both lobes; notable jagged irregular loss of edge continuity on the left distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique, non-symmetrical 'polka-dot' pigmentation pattern localized specifically to the interior white surface of the left fluke lobe.
